instance.basis: FICTIONAL. Network security logs (high-credibility, instrumented source) show a badged HVAC subcontractor's remote account traversing from the corporate IT segment onto the building-automation VLAN of one named campus and issuing after-hours commands to door-control test points. Control-system reach is directly observed, not inferred; the insider holds standing physical and logical access. Cadence across three weeks is regular rather than compressing.
